config:
# Jean Zay config for the ICD-10 synonym qualifier, self-training curriculum.
#
# The at-delimited placeholders below are substituted by jz/slurm/synonym_step.slurm from
# the variant table in jz/variants.tsv -- which is why none are named here. Kept out of the
# repo's own configs/config.yml so the colleague's file stays untouched and no hard-coded
# token travels.
#
# Two deliberate departures from the AP-HP config:
#   - the backbone is a variant axis rather than a constant. The public
#     almanach/camembertav2-base makes every result reproducible outside the consortium;
#     the restricted PARTAGES repo is measured against it rather than assumed equivalent
#     (the March-May parity was observed on the document classifier, not on this model).
#   - continue_training is False: each step retrains from scratch on the accumulated
#     positives, which is the standard self-training formulation and avoids drifting the
#     model onto the small newly-validated subset.

vars:
  # Jamais de token ici : ces configs sont générées dans $SCRATCH, lisibles, et conservées
  # comme trace d'expérience. huggingface_hub lit HF_TOKEN dans l'environnement, que le
  # script SLURM exporte depuis $WORK/.hf_token pour les seules variantes qui en ont besoin.
  hf_token: null
  data_path: "${SCRATCH}/CU2/synonym/V2_avril_2026/"
  df_pos: "noiseA_df_pos.pkl"
  df_neg: "df_neg.pkl"
  val_dataset: "phase1_test_inclusion.pkl"   # identical across steps, so the curve is comparable
  output_path: "${SCRATCH}/CU2/runs/synonym/stepNOISEA-nA-gce-s44/"
  seed: 44

model_params:
  model_name: "PARTAGES-dev/PARTAGES-camembertav2-base"
  hf_token: ${vars.hf_token}
  hidden_layer: 512
  activation: "gelu"
  dropout: 0.1
  pooling: "mean"
  sigma: 0.0
  freeze_encoder: False

model:
  "@factory": "camembert_classifier"
  model_name: ${model_params.model_name}
  hf_token: ${model_params.hf_token}
  hidden_layer: ${model_params.hidden_layer}
  activation: ${model_params.activation}
  dropout: ${model_params.dropout}
  pooling: ${model_params.pooling}
  sigma: ${model_params.sigma}
  freeze_encoder: ${model_params.freeze_encoder}

warmup_config:
  warmup_epochs: 2
  encoder_learning_rate: 1e-6
  classifier_learning_rate: 1e-3
  weight_decay: 1e-2
  sampling_probs:
    hard: 1.0
    cat: 0.
    bloc: 0.7

train_config:
  train_epochs: 80
  encoder_learning_rate: 1.0e-5
  classifier_learning_rate: 5e-5
  weight_decay: 1.0e-4
  # `hard` is the probability of drawing a pre-mined hard negative; `cat` and `bloc` are
  # cumulative thresholds on the taxonomic fallback. The AP-HP config sets hard to 0 here,
  # so the whole training phase sees only block-level negatives -- easy ones. That is the
  # first suspect for a model that memorises its positives (train acc .95, val acc .61).
  sampling_probs:
    hard: 0.0
    cat: 0.0
    bloc: 0.9

train:
  model: ${model}
  hf_token: ${vars.hf_token}
  data_path: ${vars.data_path}
  df_pos: ${vars.df_pos}
  df_neg: ${vars.df_neg}
  val_dataset: ${vars.val_dataset}
  batch_size: 180
  max_length: 200
  warmup_config: ${warmup_config}
  train_config: ${train_config}
  continue_training: False
  output_path: ${vars.output_path}
  model_weights: "best_model_stepNOISEA.pt"
  seed: ${vars.seed}
  exp_dir: "${SCRATCH}/CU2/runs/synonym/stepNOISEA-nA-gce-s44/calib"
  # The qualifier is used at a calibrated threshold, never at argmax, so the checkpoint is
  # chosen on ranking quality. Selecting on f1 picked epoch 2 of 17 on the first run -- a
  # warmup epoch, second-worst pr_auc of the whole run.
  select_metric: "pr_auc"
  min_train_acc: 0.8

infere:
  model: ${model}
  hf_token: ${vars.hf_token}
  data_path: ${vars.data_path}
  dataset: "phase1_test_inclusion.pkl"
  batch_size: 768
  max_length: 512
  output_path: ${vars.output_path}
  model_weights: "best_model_stepNOISEA.pt"
  seed: ${vars.seed}
  exp_dir: "${SCRATCH}/CU2/runs/synonym/stepNOISEA-nA-gce-s44/calib"
